name: compdb-i686-asm
description: Issue #100: a module with an MS-style __asm block for i686-pc-windows-msvc (what winnt.h has under _M_IX86), in a compile_commands.json (the runner's `prepare compdb-i686-asm`). clangd registered no MC for the target, so the compile of the module reported "MS-style inline assembly is not available: target MC unavailable", wrote no module interface, and its importer lost the module ("module 'asm_demo' not found"). The engine (mcppls-clangd 0.0.24) registers the x86 MC and assembly parser. Runs where a host can state the triple without the Windows SDK.
